page.title: mayは、可能性のドアも開く

analysis.summaryJa: 可能性のmayは道を閉じず「そうなることもあり得る」と示し、mightはさらに控えめな見込みを表す。may A, but BではAをいったん認めて本題Bへ進み、may wellは十分ありそう・もっとも、may as wellは選択肢に大差がないため「とりあえず～するのもよい」と判断する。画像の複数の扉とWELLの増幅器、AS WELLの天秤を根拠に区別する。
grammarPoints: mayは可能性が開いていることを示す
mightはmayより一歩控えめな可能性
may A, but BはAを認めつつBを本題にする
may well＋原形は十分ありそう・もっともだ
may as well＋原形は他案も同程度なので～するのもよい
visualEvidence: MAY・MAY WELL・MAY AS WELLの三つの扉が描かれる
mayは可能性あり、mightはさらに控えめという一覧がある
may A, but BがAを認めて本題Bへ進む矢印として示される
WELLの明るい増幅器とAS WELLの釣り合った天秤が強い見込みと妥協的選択を表す
commonTraps: may wellを単純な許可と解釈する
may as wellをmay wellと同じ高い可能性にする
may A, but Bでbut前を話し手の最終主張とみなす
不確かさが非常に強い文脈でmayとmightの差を無視する

questions.prompt: The replacement card may ------- within three business days.
questions.translationJa: 交換カードは3営業日以内に到着する可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: 可能性のmayの後ろには原形arriveを置きます。

questions.prompt: The outdoor tour ------- be canceled, but the forecast is still uncertain.
questions.translationJa: 屋外ツアーは中止になるかもしれませんが、予報はまだ不確かです。
questions.explanationJa: 不確かさを強く示す文脈なので、mayより控えめなmightが適切です。

questions.prompt: The office may be small, ------- it is conveniently located.
questions.translationJa: そのオフィスは小さいかもしれませんが、便利な場所にあります。
questions.explanationJa: may A, but BでAを認めた後、本題Bを提示します。

questions.prompt: With traffic this heavy, the delivery may ------- arrive after six.
questions.translationJa: この激しい交通量では、配送は6時過ぎになる可能性が十分あります。
questions.explanationJa: may well＋原形は根拠のある高めの可能性を示します。

questions.prompt: The last train has left, so we may ------- take a taxi.
questions.translationJa: 終電が出たので、タクシーに乗るのもよいでしょう。
questions.explanationJa: 他に良い選択肢がない状況ではmay as well＋原形を使います。

questions.prompt: The figures are preliminary and may ------- change after the audit.
questions.translationJa: その数値は暫定的で、監査後も変更になる可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: may still changeで可能性がなお残ることを表します。

questions.prompt: The consultant may have experience, ------- she is unfamiliar with our system.
questions.translationJa: そのコンサルタントには経験があるかもしれませんが、当社のシステムには不慣れです。
questions.explanationJa: Aを認めつつ対照的な本題Bへ進むmay A, but Bです。

questions.prompt: The tenant may ------- have misunderstood the renewal notice.
questions.translationJa: 入居者は更新通知を誤解した可能性が十分あります。
questions.explanationJa: may well have＋過去分詞で過去についての十分あり得る推量を表します。

questions.prompt: No buses are running, so we might ------- walk to the venue.
questions.translationJa: バスが運行していないので、会場まで歩くのもよいでしょう。
questions.explanationJa: might as wellも妥協的な選択を少し控えめに示します。

questions.prompt: The delay may ------- be brief; the technician is already on site.
questions.translationJa: 技術者はすでに現地にいるため、遅延は短く済む可能性が十分あります。
questions.explanationJa: 根拠に基づく高めの見込みをmay well beで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence expressing an open possibility.

choices.A: The supplier may sends a revised estimate today.
choices.B: The supplier may to send a revised estimate today.
choices.C: The supplier does may send a revised estimate today.
choices.D: The supplier may send a revised estimate today.

questions.translationJa: 仕入先は今日、修正版の見積を送るかもしれません。
questions.explanationJa: 可能性のmayの後ろは原形sendです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence expressing a particularly tentative possibility.

choices.A: The interview must run longer than planned.
choices.B: The interview might run longer than planned.
choices.C: The interview might runs longer than planned.
choices.D: The interview does might run longer than planned.

questions.translationJa: 面接は予定より長引くかもしれません。
questions.explanationJa: 控えめな見込みをmight＋原形runで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct concession structure.

choices.A: The hotel may be old, so it is well maintained.
choices.B: The hotel may old but is maintaining well.
choices.C: The hotel may be old, but it is well maintained.
choices.D: The hotel may be old because but maintained.

questions.translationJa: そのホテルは古いかもしれませんが、よく手入れされています。
questions.explanationJa: may A, but BがAを認めて評価の本題Bを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence meaning “This is quite likely.”

choices.A: The request may well be approved.
choices.B: The request may as well be approved.
choices.C: The request may well to be approved.

questions.translationJa: その申請は承認される可能性が十分あります。
questions.explanationJa: 高めの可能性はmay well＋原形beで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence suggesting a reasonable fallback.

choices.A: The café is closed, so we may well eat at the station.
choices.B: The café is closed, so we may as well to eat at the station.
choices.C: The café is closed, so we as may well eat at the station.
choices.D: The café is closed, so we may as well eat at the station.

questions.translationJa: カフェが閉まっているので、駅で食べるのもよいでしょう。
questions.explanationJa: 他案が乏しい状況でmay as well＋原形を使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a remaining possibility.

choices.A: The schedule may still changes before Friday.
choices.B: The schedule does may still change before Friday.
choices.C: The schedule may still change before Friday.
choices.D: The schedule may to still change before Friday.

questions.translationJa: 日程は金曜日までにまだ変わる可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: may still＋原形changeで可能性が残ることを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence acknowledging one point before the main contrast.

choices.A: The device may be inexpensive, because repairs are costly.
choices.B: The device may be inexpensive, but repairs are costly.
choices.C: The device may inexpensive but repairs costly are.
choices.D: The device may be inexpensive, so repairs are costly.

questions.translationJa: その機器は安価かもしれませんが、修理費は高額です。
questions.explanationJa: 価格の利点を認めつつ、but以下を本題として提示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct strong-possibility sentence about the past.

choices.A: The email may as well have gone to spam.
choices.B: The email may well has gone to spam.
choices.C: The email well may have went to spam.
choices.D: The email may well have gone to the spam folder.

questions.translationJa: そのメールは迷惑メールフォルダーに入った可能性が十分あります。
questions.explanationJa: may well have goneで過去の高い可能性を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct fallback suggestion.

choices.A: Since we are early, we might well review the agenda.
choices.B: Since we are early, we might as well to review the agenda.
choices.C: Since we are early, we might as well review the agenda.
choices.D: Since we are early, we as might well review the agenda.

questions.translationJa: 早く着いたので、議題を確認しておくのもよいでしょう。
questions.explanationJa: 空き時間の妥当な利用をmight as well＋原形で提案します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct likely explanation.

choices.A: The repeated error may well be caused by old software.
choices.B: The repeated error may as well be caused by old software.
choices.C: The repeated error may well caused by old software.
choices.D: The repeated error well may be cause by old software.

questions.translationJa: 繰り返すエラーは旧式ソフトウェアが原因である可能性が十分あります。
questions.explanationJa: may well be causedで受動の高い可能性を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The package may arrive on Friday."

choices.A: Friday arrival is possible but not certain.
choices.C: The package definitely arrived on Friday.

questions.translationJa: 金曜日に到着する可能性はありますが、確実ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: mayは可能性の扉が開いていることを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The meeting might finish by noon."

choices.A: The meeting must finish by noon.
choices.B: The meeting definitely finishes at noon.
choices.C: The meeting has permission to finish.
choices.D: Finishing by noon is a rather tentative possibility.

questions.translationJa: 正午までに終わるという見込みは、かなり控えめです。
questions.explanationJa: mightはmayより一歩引いた可能性を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The route may be longer, but it is safer."

choices.A: Because the route is longer, it cannot be safe.
choices.B: The route is both shorter and less safe.
choices.C: Although the route is possibly longer, its safety is the main advantage.
choices.D: The route may be closed unless it is longer.

questions.translationJa: その道は長いかもしれませんが、安全性が主な利点です。
questions.explanationJa: may A, but BではAを認め、Bを中心的な評価として示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The client may well accept the revised terms."

choices.A: The client has permission to accept.
choices.B: There is good reason to expect the client to accept.
choices.C: The client should accept only as a last resort.
choices.D: The client has already rejected the terms.

questions.translationJa: 顧客が修正条件を受け入れると期待する十分な理由があります。
questions.explanationJa: may wellは単なる可能性より高い見込みを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We may as well take the later train."

choices.A: Since no option is clearly better, taking the later train is reasonable.
choices.B: The later train is very likely to be full.
choices.C: We have formal permission to take the train.
choices.D: Taking the later train is mandatory.

questions.translationJa: 明らかにより良い選択肢がないため、遅い列車に乗るのが妥当です。
questions.explanationJa: may as wellは選択肢に大差がないときの妥協的判断です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The policy may still change."
questions.translationJa: 制度変更の可能性はまだ残っています。
questions.explanationJa: may stillが残存する可能性を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The plan may save money, but it will take more time."

choices.A: The plan definitely saves both money and time.
choices.B: The plan may fail because no time is available.
choices.C: Saving money is the only important point.
choices.D: The time cost outweighs or qualifies the possible saving.

questions.translationJa: 費用削減の可能性はありますが、時間面の負担がその利点を限定します。
questions.explanationJa: but以下が話し手の本題・留保です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The key may well have been left at reception."

choices.A: Reception is a quite plausible location for the missing key.
choices.B: The key was definitely handed to reception.
choices.C: Leaving the key at reception was permitted.
choices.D: The key should be moved as a fallback.

questions.translationJa: 紛失した鍵が受付にある可能性はかなり高いです。
questions.explanationJa: may well have been leftは過去の高い可能性です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We might as well postpone the call."

choices.A: The call is very likely to be postponed automatically.
choices.B: Postponing is a reasonable choice because the alternatives offer little benefit.
choices.C: We are forbidden to hold the call.
choices.D: The call has already been postponed.

questions.translationJa: 他の選択肢に大きな利点がないため、通話を延期するのが妥当です。
questions.explanationJa: might as wellは控えめな妥協案を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The lower total may well be correct."

choices.A: The lower total is certainly wrong.
choices.B: The lower total has official permission.
choices.C: The evidence makes the lower total quite plausible.
choices.D: We should choose the lower total as a fallback.

questions.translationJa: 証拠から見ると、低い方の合計が正しい可能性は十分あります。
questions.explanationJa: may well be correctは根拠のある高めの可能性を示します。

questions.prompt: The parcel has cleared customs. It may ------- at the branch tomorrow.
questions.translationJa: 荷物は通関を終えたため、明日支店に届く可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: 開かれた可能性をmay＋原形arriveで表します。

questions.prompt: The forecast changes every hour, and confidence is low. The ferry ------- be delayed.
questions.translationJa: 予報は毎時変わり確度も低いため、フェリーは遅れるかもしれません。
questions.explanationJa: 低い確度には控えめなmightが合います。

questions.prompt: The candidate may lack industry experience, ------- she has excellent analytical skills.
questions.translationJa: その応募者には業界経験がないかもしれませんが、優れた分析力があります。
questions.explanationJa: 弱点を認めた後、but以下の強みを本題にします。

questions.prompt: The roads are icy and visibility is poor. The driver may ------- arrive late.
questions.translationJa: 道路が凍結し視界も悪いため、運転手が遅れて到着する可能性は十分あります。
questions.explanationJa: 複数の根拠がある高い見込みをmay wellで表します。

questions.prompt: Our appointment was canceled, and we are already downtown. We may ------- visit the showroom.
questions.translationJa: 予約が取り消され、すでに中心街にいるので、ショールームへ行くのもよいでしょう。
questions.explanationJa: 他案より明確に劣らない妥協案をmay as wellで表します。

questions.prompt: The budget has not been approved. The launch date may ------- change.
questions.translationJa: 予算が未承認なので、発売日はまだ変更になる可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: 未確定状況で可能性が残ることをmay still changeで表します。

questions.prompt: The venue may be farther from the station, ------- it offers twice as much space.
questions.translationJa: その会場は駅から遠いかもしれませんが、2倍の広さがあります。
questions.explanationJa: 不利な点を認め、本題の利点へbutで進みます。

questions.prompt: The address on the form is outdated. The invoice may ------- have been sent to the old office.
questions.translationJa: 書類の住所が古いため、請求書が旧オフィスへ送られた可能性が十分あります。
questions.explanationJa: 過去のもっともらしい説明をmay well have been sentで表します。

questions.prompt: Only ten minutes remain before boarding. We might ------- buy coffee after we land.
questions.translationJa: 搭乗まで10分しかないので、コーヒーは到着後に買うのもよいでしょう。
questions.explanationJa: 時間が少なく代案が同程度なのでmight as wellが自然です。

questions.prompt: The revised forecast uses complete sales data. Its lower estimate may ------- be accurate.
questions.translationJa: 修正予測は完全な売上データを使っているため、低い方の見積が正確な可能性は十分あります。
questions.explanationJa: 十分な根拠があるのでmay well beで高めの可能性を示します。
